title: Virtual Compute: evt combination
content:
## Retired clause 1

This former Virtual Compute handling clause is no longer in force: “A current Northbridge Enterprise Support holding for the same customer and billing entity provides assisted invoice explanation, but does not itself reduce this category price or waive debt.” Its basis has been superseded.

## Retired clause 2

This former Virtual Compute handling clause is no longer in force: “The combination changes only request-channel eligibility, not approval authority.” Its basis has been superseded.

## Retired clause 3

This former Virtual Compute handling clause is no longer in force: “A promotional primary-price entitlement is suppressed wherever a commitment price covers the same quantity, and no benefit from an unrelated category is stacked.” Its basis has been superseded.

## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — An approved negotiated rate is a contract-specific override; the presence of a paid support holding makes assisted negotiated-amendment intake available through support as well as portal and api. Without that combination the signed amendment is submitted through portal or api.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for evt combination?**

the presence of a paid support holding makes assisted negotiated-amendment intake available through support as well as portal and api.

superseded_clauses: A current Northbridge Enterprise Support holding for the same customer and billing entity provides assisted invoice explanation, but does not itself reduce this category price or waive debt.
The combination changes only request-channel eligibility, not approval authority.
A promotional primary-price entitlement is suppressed wherever a commitment price covers the same quantity, and no benefit from an unrelated category is stacked.
